// 엔진에서 송신 모듈 직접 import·전역 fetch·동적 import로 egress를 우회하려는 시도(D01 §3, ADR-028 결정 6).
import http from 'node:http';
import https from 'https';
import { connect } from 'net';
import { request } from 'undici';
import WebSocket from 'ws';
import { net } from 'electron';
const m = 'node:' + 'http';
export const f = () => [fetch('https://x'), globalThis.fetch, http, https, connect, request, WebSocket, net, import(m), import('node:tls')];
